title: Active Large Language Model-Based Knowledge Distillation for Session-Based Recommendation

live_model.evidence: "We adopt the GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 as the LLM teacher to distill knowledge from 500 instances for all datasets and backbones" -- a training-time difficulty/rationale generator for the KD framework.

prompt.location: Sec Implementation Details (difficulty-based gain-value assignment described); no verbatim teacher prompt located

claim.metric: none for GPT-4-turbo itself (recall@5/10 and ndcg@5/10 in the results tables are for the student recommenders -- FPMC/STAMP/AttMix with various KD methods including the paper's own ALKDRec -- not for GPT-4-turbo)

data.source: Hetrec2011-ML, Amazon-Games and other public session-based recommendation datasets

notes: GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 plays a teacher/annotator role, scoring training-instance difficulty to guide knowledge distillation into small recommender models; no capability metric is reported for GPT-4-turbo's own output.
